scope: Sources and source contracts; no Dune queries executed by this agent
conclusion: A complete current swap-level and solver-level history is not established from public NEAR logs. Official historical 1Click Explorer access requires partner authentication; the documented Explorer response does not identify solvers.

sources.access: Partner JWT required for every request; obtain from Partner Dashboard. One request per five seconds per partner.
sources.scope: Historical 1Click swaps, not necessarily every protocol integration.
sources.ingestion: Read-only GET /transactions; no browser scraping or auth bypass.

sources.grain: One explorer transaction record identified by deposit address and optional memo; validate uniqueness and source lifecycle before treating as an immutable swap key.

pagination.direction: next for older; prev for newer

sources.limits: Timestamp boundaries are exclusive. Successful records only for completed swap notional. In-flight amounts can be zero by design. No documented solver identity or completion timestamp.

sources.change: Official changelog says 1Click swaps settle on NEAR Private Shard. nearTxHashes carries shield/unshield hashes rather than the swap hash; Explorer still presents swap data.
sources.implication: Public intents.near logs are not a complete current swap census. Do not interpret a decline in public logs as a matching decline in total usage.

sources.interpretation: A successful token_diff is one signed account-side token change, not necessarily one user swap. Multiple sides and multi-asset intents may settle in one receipt. Transfers and withdrawals are not swaps.

sources.filters: Bounded completed UTC days, executor intents.near, success execution status, parsed standard dip4 and exact token_diff event. Audit malformed JSON, null keys, duplicate and conflicting event versions.
sources.semanticKey: Preserve contract + intent_hash + account_id; do not silently dedup conflicting payloads.

sources.access: Public/private relay connections require Partner JWT; private relay URL obtained from team. solver_id is solver configuration, not a documented public historical registry.
sources.implication: Do not equate signer, relayer or absent referral with verified solver. Identity-to-organization mapping requires evidence and versioning.

sources.limits: Configured appFees are not a complete paid-fee ledger. Authentication, route and partner policy affect split/minimums; actual execution and fee aggregation require reconciliation. ANY_INPUT standing collectors can produce repeated sweeps and must not be assumed single-use user orders.

sources.use: Resolve originAsset and destinationAsset against versioned asset metadata; retain exact token contract, chain, decimals and alias history. Symbols alone do not identify assets.

sources.grain: Date/source_type/token; provider aggregate, not order-level routes or wallet behaviors.
sources.limitation: Public and confidential volume add under official convention, but token blockchain is not proof of actual funding source chain.

sources.status: Discovery only; rejected as verified solver count
sources.reason: Labels every no-referral token_diff signer as a solver. Missing referral does not establish role; test, relay and generic account activity can enter. Count is public-side signing accounts rather than solver organizations.

implementationContract.canonicalOrderKey: Prefer provider immutable order ID if supplied; otherwise validate depositAddress + depositMemo + creation timestamp and record source version. Deposit/memo cursor is not itself proof of permanent uniqueness for standing collectors.
implementationContract.eventTime: Explorer createdAt is order creation, not terminal settlement. Store created and ingestion times separately and do not call creation-to-observation latency settlement duration.
implementationContract.route: Use explicit origin/destination chain fields or registry-backed asset representation plus depositType/recipientType. INTENTS origin is internal inventory; asset representation alone cannot prove last funding chain.
implementationContract.notional: One validated successful user order, one chosen side USD amount, with valuation coverage. Never add input + output or both signed intent counterparties.
implementationContract.solver: Nullable verified solver ID with label evidence and coverage denominator. Do not infer role merely from solver-like name or no referral.
implementationContract.fees: Separate configured appFee, observed protocol fee, distribution fee, solver spread and captured receipts. Missing fee is not zero.
implementationContract.dedup: Upsert mutable explorer status by validated order key. Preserve raw records and source retrieval time; repoll open orders and overlap windows. Public event duplicate conflicts quarantine.
implementationContract.filtering: Deterministic validity exclusions first. Automation flags and suspected circular activity separate from hard wash exclusion. Publish unclassified and unpriced shares; do not claim organic volume by subtraction alone.
implementationContract.reconciliation: Compare only equivalent windows/scopes with official aggregate. Document 1Click coverage and public/confidential splits; do not force raw public totals to all-source published metrics.
